rateLimits.note: Business Profile APIs: 300 queries a minute ("Default requests"). Places API (New) has a per-minute quota per method per project that Google does not publish as a figure (the Cloud console shows it): the Business Profile figure is written over both, the stricter form. writeUrl makes no call.

"10 per minute per Google Business Profile" edits, which cannot be increased; whether a review reply counts as an edit is not said: written for replies, the stricter reading (scope key stands for the profile).

provenance.notes: Places policies read on 2026-11-10: Google Maps Content is cached or stored only as the Service Specific Terms allow; place IDs may be stored indefinitely (the provider keeps nothing else); no pre-fetching, indexing, storing or redistributing outside the Services (caching and storage forbidden, maxTtl 0, as Terms::cacheFor 0). Attribution: the Google Maps logo, or the text "Google Maps" unchanged where space is short; every review credited to its author (name, photo, profile link; the photo at least); a link to the review on Google Maps (googleMapsUri). Commercial use is not addressed (a paid Google Maps Platform service): unknown. Business Profile limits from developers.google.com/my-business/content/limits: 300 QPM per API, 10 edits a minute per profile. A Places API key, or the owner's OAuth client and refresh token.
